purpose: Two things the PJM/DOM case study needs as an industry anchor: (a) the data-centre contract pipeline by contract type, and (b) project-level transmission reinforcements with Dominion's own cost estimates, both taken from Dominion Energy's Integrated Resource Plan documents.

conventions.contract_growth: MW at the end of July of each year, as published in Figure 2.1.15
conventions.project_cost: cost_musd is the dollar figure printed beside each project in the IRP appendix, in millions of USD, i.e. Dominion's own planning-grade estimate

caveats: The four contract categories are not additive in the reader's intuition: ELOAs are early-stage agreements, so 'total contracts' is a pipeline measure, not energised load.
Costs are planning estimates from IRP appendices, not awarded contracts; the 2025 and 2026 updates differ for the same project (e.g. Mars-Golden: 342.9 in 2025 vs 565.0 in 2026).
Rows were parsed from PDF text with a regex; the parsed table is a convenience extract, the PDF remains the source of record.
